incb.title: Report of the International Narcotics Control Board for 2023 (E/INCB/2023/1), chapter II, paras. 70-72
incb.note: As at 1 November 2023 the INCB counts 186 parties to the 1961 Convention as amended (Chad party to the unamended text only), 184 to the 1971 Convention and 192 to the 1988 Convention (191 States and the European Union); its counts and its lists of non-parties match ours (INCB 'Nauru' is the UN's 'Naoero'). This is the latest INCB statement that could be read: the reports for 2024 and 2025 on incb.org returned fetch errors. No participant entry in the treaty tables is dated after 20 October 2023.
